summary.name: Claude Help Center
summary.one_liner: The official support site for Anthropic's Claude, organized into article collections on plans, team and enterprise administration, identity management, and the Claude API and Console.
use_cases: Compare Claude paid plans and manage a subscription
Set up and administer Claude for a team or organization
Configure single sign-on and user provisioning
Manage Claude API keys, usage and billing in the Console
summary.what_it_does: The page is the landing page of the Claude Help Center, a support knowledge base for Anthropic's Claude products. It lists four collections of articles: Pro and Max plans (15 articles), Team and Enterprise plans (76 articles), Identity management covering SSO, JIT and SCIM (15 articles), and Claude API and Console (41 articles). The page itself offers a search box and topic browsing rather than tutorials or product features. The page text does not describe specific features beyond these topic summaries.
notable: Covers both consumer paid plans (Pro and Max) and organization plans (Team and Enterprise)
Includes identity management guidance for SSO, JIT provisioning and SCIM directory sync
Listed as Anthropic's official Claude Code cheatsheet source in the awesome-claude-code list
caveats: Page text is a topic index only; specific plan prices and details are not shown on this page
Relevant articles are behind the collection links rather than on this page
